tracks-legend-panel.location-help: Enter a position (1:100000), a range (1:100000-200000), or chromosome-qualified ranges (1:100000-3:200000). Separate multiple regions with |. Changes apply when you leave the field; an empty field restores the current location.

ecdna.plot-help: One lane per walk, grouped into families of nested variants (shortest at the top). Each node is drawn as an arrow in its strand direction on the same genomic axis as the genes and the cell heatmap below; red arcs are ALT junctions, a stub with a dot marks a junction whose partner lies outside the visible regions (click it to open that region). Hover a walk to isolate it, click to highlight it, double-click to zoom to it; Cmd/Ctrl + wheel zooms, drag pans.
ecdna.plot-click: click: highlight · double-click: zoom to this walk
ecdna.plot-anchor: partner outside the view: click to open it as an extra panel
ecdna.track-title: Walks on the genome ({{count}} ticked) over the cell heatmap
ecdna.track-help: One row per ticked walk, longest at the bottom: its nodes on the genome axis shared with the heatmap below (lighter = reverse strand), red arcs are ALT junctions joining non-adjacent pieces (the closing junction of a circle included). Variants of one species stack as nested rows; the heatmap underneath is the full single-cell heatmap zoomed to these regions (same zoom, strips and tracks as the Single-Cell tab). Click a row to focus it.
ecdna.contain-few: Tick at least two walks to compare them.
ecdna.contain-help: Left: the nesting hierarchy. Each walk sits under the shortest walk that holds at least 90% of its genome (⊂ k · % = inside walk k, by how much). Rare walks (≤ the shared threshold of carrier cells) collapse into a '+n rare' row under the walk they overlap most. Right, on the same rows: the fraction of the row walk's genome inside each column walk (columns numbered as the rows; empty = 0). Click a walk to show it in the single-walk card.
ecdna.scatter-too-few: {{count}} cells carry both (< {{min}}): too few for a correlation
ecdna.contain-scale: share of row walk inside column walk
ecdna.heat-title: Copy number of every cell over the walk's regions
ecdna.heat-help: Each cell's total copy number (the single-cell heatmap's colours) over the regions the walk is built from, with the padding on each side; above, the walk's nodes on the same coordinates (red outline = ALT junction end) and the genes; right, the walk's copies per cell. CN steps at the node boundaries that follow the copies bar support the walk.
ecdna.title: ecDNA / amplicon walks ({{count}} in the genome graph)
ecdna.none: No walks exported for this patient (pipeline step `walks`: db/amplicon_copies/all_patients.rds → walks.json).
ecdna.table-help: Walks are the junction-balanced cycles / paths of the patient's merged genome graph with a copy number per cell; most are spurious. Carriers are cells with ≥ the carrier threshold; median copies are over carriers. Curated = passed the pipeline's cn_filter. Tick walks to show them on the tree and in the co-occurrence views; click a name for its structure.
ecdna.pick-walk: Click a walk in the table to draw it.
ecdna.diagram-help: Ring: the walk's nodes in order, length proportional to genomic width, coloured by chromosome, ▶ strand; red dots are ALT junctions (ends of two non-adjacent pieces of genome joined); labels are genes overlapping the nodes (the walk's driver genes in red). Below: the same nodes on their chromosomes (lighter = reverse strand).
ecdna.none-selected: Tick walks in the table to show them here.
ecdna.tree-help: Columns are grouped by amplicon family (nested walks). Σ is the family total: summed copies per cell, stacked by walk colour. Walks carried by few cells (≤ the rare threshold) share one narrow 'rare' column: a coloured tick per walk present. Column width follows prevalence; the number in each header is the column maximum. Hatched rows have no walk counts (not zero). Below the columns: per clone, % of cells carrying each walk and median copies in carriers. Hover a row for all of that cell's walks; click a row or a tree node to select those cells (Shift adds).
ecdna.rare-help: Walks carried by this many cells or fewer are 'rare': folded into one row or column per family (walk copies, co-occurrence), listed after the others (copy scatter) and collapsed in the nesting tree. Dashed chips above are rare. Shared by every ecDNA panel.
ecdna.tc-no-data: no walk counts for this cell
ecdna.tc-summary-tip: {{clone}}: {{pct}} of {{measured}} cells carry {{walk}}; median {{median}} copies in carriers
ecdna.upset-help: Each column is a combination of walks present together in the same cells (≥ the 'Carrier ≥ copies' filter above); bars count cells, the right-hand numbers are carriers per row. Rare walks (≤ the shared rare threshold of carrier cells) are folded into one grey 'rare · family' row per family; hover it for its walks. Click a column to select its cells.
ecdna.scatter-title: Copies of one walk vs another
ecdna.scatter-help: One point per cell, coloured by clone. Walks on the same molecule move together; separate ecDNA species carrying different drivers scatter independently.
ecdna.intro: Walks come from the pipeline's junction-balanced genome graph (gGnome gWalk) with per-cell copy numbers from the CPLEX fit; exported by skilift::sc_export_walks.

rates.title: Mutation rates along the tree
rates.help: Each row is a clade of ≥ 3 cells: SNV sites gained on the branch above it (with alt reads in the clade, in none of its sibling clades), divided by the median callable megabases of its cells, and the per-cell rate of private SNVs per callable Mb inside the clade versus the rest of the tumor (median, fold change, two-sided Mann-Whitney). Clades flagged faster/slower (p < 0.01, fold ≥ 1.5) have a different ongoing mutation rate. Click a row to select the clade. Normal cells are left out of every clade and comparison.

timing.title: Amplification timing
timing.help: For each strong tier 1–2 amplification, the SNV sites inside the amplified segment in its carrier cells (depth ≥ 6) are classified by estimated mutant copies (VAF × CN): ≥ 1.5 copies means the SNV preceded the amplification and was duplicated with it, ~1 copy that it arose afterwards. A low pre-amplification fraction (< 30%) indicates an early amplification; a high one (> 60%) a late amplification. Hover the site count for the per-site copies; click the gene for the alteration popup.

history.title: Clonal history
history.shift: {{signature}} rises to {{share}} of the mutations gained on this branch ({{delta}} vs the parent clade)
history.help: Phylogeny collapsed to clades of at least {{min}} cells (wedges, one row each; lower 'Min clade' for more detail). {{count}} tier 1–2 alterations sit at the end of the branch leading to the clade their carrier cells fit best (truncal ones on the root stem); grey numbers are SNV sites gained on a branch (seen in the clade, absent from its siblings), coloured tags the signature whose share rises most on that branch. Click a node or wedge to select its cells, an alteration for its popup.
history.folded: {{count}} more cells in clades below the size cut (folded in here)
history.select: Click to select these cells (Shift adds)
history.gained: {{count}} SNV sites gained on this branch

help.walks: Cycles / paths of the patient's junction-balanced genome graph (gGnome gWalk) with a copy number per cell from the CPLEX fit. Carriers = cells with ≥ the carrier threshold; median copies over carriers; curated = passed the pipeline's cn_filter. Most walks are spurious — use the cell and copy filters.
help.cohort-de: Pooled: patients' matrices merged on gene names, one Wilcoxon rank-sum test per gene between groups A and B, log2FC = log2((Σ expm1(A) + 1) / nA) − log2((Σ expm1(B) + 1) / nB) (Seurat), BH q-values. Per patient: the same test inside each patient with ≥ 3 cells in both groups; p-values combined by Fisher's method, log2FC averaged, concordance = patients whose fold change has the cohort sign.
help.cohort-pca: Up to 1,500 of the compared cells (evenly subsampled), the 1,000 most variable non-mitochondrial genes z-scored across those cells, top 10 PCs by power iteration on the cell × cell Gram matrix; variance explained = eigenvalue / total scaled variance; loadings = gene projections on each unit component.
help.program-score: Mean over a gene set of each gene's z-score across one patient's cells; per-patient scaling removes patient batch from the score.
help.title: How the single-cell scores are computed
help.clade-fit: Best F1 between the cells carrying an alteration and any clade of the phylogeny (1 = the carriers are exactly one clade). Alterations with fit ≥ 0.7 are called clade-consistent.
help.clade-score: F1 of a site's alt-read calls against the clade the site was mapped to on the tree: alt cells inside the clade count as true positives, alt cells outside as false positives, ref cells inside as false negatives.
help.strong-events: Homozygous deletions in ≥ 10% of cells; any other alteration in ≥ 3 cells and ≥ 5% of cells. The default filter of the oncoprint, report and convergence views.
help.amplified-snv: An SNV site in a cell with total copy number ≥ 4 where VAF × CN ≥ 1.5 estimated mutant copies, i.e. the mutation sits on the amplified allele.
help.fga: Fraction of the genome whose copy number differs from the cell's rounded ploidy (its modal copy number).
help.map-confidence: Confidence of the site's placement on the tree from the pipeline (0–1); low values are sites whose alt cells scatter across clades.
help.categories: Truncal: present in the tumor MRCA (all tumor cells); subclonal: mapped to an internal clade; private: a single cell.
help.joint-fit: All sites of a patient are fitted together to COSMIC v3.4 SBS signatures (SigProfilerAssignment on the server, or NNLS with forward selection in the browser).
help.assignment: Each mutation is assigned the signature with the highest posterior P(signature | channel) ∝ activity × profile for its 96-channel context. Per-cell and per-clone burdens are the number of distinct assigned mutations seen in those cells.
help.clade-vs-rest: Fisher's exact test of a signature's assigned mutation count inside a clade against the rest of the tree (2 × 2: signature / other × clade / rest).
help.bootstrap: Signature shares re-fitted on resampled mutation sets (100 rounds); the interval is the 2.5–97.5 percentile.
help.tumor-only: Hides RNA cells annotated as non-malignant (by state or cell type) before computing composition, markers and dosage.
help.markers: Seurat FindAllMarkers from the pipeline (Wilcoxon, log2FC and adjusted p) per state, clone or cluster; the browser fallback is a Mann-Whitney test on the loaded cells.
help.dosage: Spearman correlation between a gene's total copy number and its expression across linked cells; genes are ranked by rho and p.
help.composition: Shares of RNA states per clone or cluster, with a chi-square test of independence between the two groupings.
help.oncoprint: Strong tier ≤ 2 alterations per patient; colour is the alteration class, the number inside is the fraction of cells carrying it.
help.per-mb: Per-cell SNV count divided by the callable megabases of that cell (bases with sufficient coverage in the pipeline's coverage track).
help.convergence: Genes altered in ≥ 2 patients, with each alteration's clonality: clonal ≥ 85% of cells, subclonal 10–85%, rare < 10%.
help.sigmat: Signature share per patient in truncal vs later (subclonal + private) sites, with a Fisher's exact test per cell (* p < 0.01).

single-cell.no-cells: No cells are linked to this patient. Cells are datafiles.json entries with entry_type "cell" and this patient's patient_id.

snv.clade-score-help: How cleanly a site's alt calls follow the clade it maps to: F1 of 'alt call' vs 'in the mapped clade' over cells with a genotype call, 2·alt in clade / (2·alt in clade + ref in clade + alt outside). 1 = every called cell in the clade is alt and no called cell outside it is.
snv.amplified-help: Sites whose carrier cells have copy number ≥ 4 at the site with an estimated ≥ 1.5 mutant copies (VAF × CN): the mutation was present before the amplification.

selection.title: Selected cells
selection.empty: Click a cell in the tree or heatmap to pull it up.
selection.track-limit: Tracks are shown for the first {{limit}} selected cells.

tracks.title: Cell tracks
tracks.error: {{track}} could not be loaded for this cell
tracks.no-fit: No coverage fit (slope / intercept) for this cell, so raw counts are shown.
tracks.empty: Select cells in the tree or heatmap to see their tracks.

cohort.clade-filter-help: Hide alterations whose carrier cells do not match one clade of the patient's phylogeny (best F1 below the threshold); scattered subclonal drivers are mostly noise. Applies to the patient cards, oncoprint, convergence, event table and reports.
cohort.amp-help: Each strip is one ecDNA walk of one patient (up to six per patient passing the filters): the copies of the walk in every cell that carries it, with the fraction of the patient's cells carrying it below. Walks come from the patients' walks.json (pipeline step walks).
cohort.amp-empty: No walks exported for these patients (pipeline step walks).
cohort.amp-upset-title: Co-existing amplicons in the same cells
cohort.amp-upset-help: Walks are grouped by their driver gene set (columns); each row of a patient is a combination of gene-set amplicons found together in the same cells at ≥ the copy threshold, with the fraction (count) of the patient's cells.
cohort.amp-scatter-title: Gene copy number vs gene copy number
cohort.amp-scatter-help: Total copy number of two genes per cell (from each cell's CN segments, log scale) per patient with Spearman ρ: genes on the same amplicon rise together, genes on different ecDNA species do not.
cohort.de-pca-intro: Run PCA on all tumor cells of the loaded patients, or set groups A / B above to run it on just those cells and compare their PC scores.
cohort.umap-drag: Drag a box to select cells
cohort.de-help: Build A and B from patients × a metadata field, from cells boxed on the cohort UMAP (Shift adds), or let B be every other cell. Pooled: one Wilcoxon test per gene on the merged cells (log2FC as Seurat). Per patient: the test runs inside each patient with ≥ 3 cells in both groups and the p-values are combined (Fisher); the concordance column counts patients whose fold change has the cohort sign — the way to find differences that hold in every tumor rather than in the biggest one.
cohort.de-summary: {{tested}} genes tested · {{up}} up, {{down}} down at the thresholds · A {{nA}} cells, B {{nB}} cells
cohort.de-pick-gene: Click a gene on the volcano or in the table for its expression per patient and group.
cohort.de-pca-help: Genes are z-scored over the included cells (so patient differences dominate the first PCs unless the groups sit inside one patient); PCs by power iteration on the cell Gram matrix; up to 1,500 cells (subsampled evenly beyond that). Click a PC bar to plot it; tags are the genes with the largest positive / negative loadings (click to open in the gene explorer).
cohort.gs-title: Program scores and marker dot plot
cohort.gs-placeholder: Gene symbols separated by commas, spaces or newlines
cohort.gs-intro: Pick a built-in program (Neftel GBM states, cell cycle, hypoxia, interferon) or paste a gene list, then score it in every patient; the scores also colour the cohort UMAP.
cohort.gs-help: Score = mean over the set's genes of each gene's z-score across that patient's cells (per-patient scaling keeps batch out of the score). Left: by patient; right: by the grouping field, with a Kruskal-Wallis / Mann-Whitney test across levels.
cohort.gs-dots-intro: Loads every patient's matrix and plots the top shared markers (from the pipeline's FindAllMarkers, ≥ 2 patients) per level; falls back to the gene list of the score view.
cohort.gs-dots-empty: None of the genes were found in the matrices.
cohort.gs-dots-help: Dot size is the fraction of cells with non-zero expression, colour the mean expression z-scored across columns per gene. Pooled columns weight patients by cell number.
cohort.sc-title: RNA programs by clone and patient
cohort.sc-help: One panel per patient: for every group of the row field (clone, cluster …) with ≥ 3 cells, the share of each level of the fill field (state …). The chi-square test asks whether composition differs between the rows within that patient; the same clone → program association recurring across patients is the cohort-level finding.
cohort.sig-clones-empty: No clone-level fits ("clone: …" sets) in signatures.json.
cohort.sig-help-evolution: SigProfilerAssignment fits (COSMIC v3.4) from each patient's signatures.json, for the truncal (tumor MRCA), subclonal and private site sets side by side; hover a segment for the aetiology, hover a signature to follow it across patients. By Count scales the bars by the number of mutations in each set.
cohort.sig-help-slope: Each panel is one signature: a line per patient from its share of truncal mutations to its share of later (subclonal + private) mutations; the dashed line is the cohort mean and the number the mean change. Rising lines are processes that switched on after the MRCA.
cohort.sig-help-matrix: Signature share (or mutation count) per patient for truncal and later sites. * marks a later-site count that differs from the truncal count by Fisher's exact test (p < 0.01); hover a cell for the odds ratio.
cohort.sig-help-spectra: 96-channel substitution spectra of the loaded SNV sites per patient (all or one tree category), and the pairwise cosine similarity of those spectra — a similarity below ~0.8 means different dominant processes.
cohort.sig-help-clones: Backend fits per clone (the "clone: …" sets of signatures.json), grouped by patient.
cohort.sig-help-table: One row per signature: how many patients carry it at ≥ 5% of their fitted mutations, its mean share across patients, its mean truncal and later shares and the resulting trend.
cohort.sigmat-help: Share of a patient's truncal / later (subclonal + private) mutations assigned to each signature; * p < 0.01 (Fisher, truncal vs later).
cohort.conv-mixed: Truncal in some, subclonal in others
cohort.conv-help: Genes altered in several patients and the clonality of the alteration in each (clonal ≥ 85% of cells, subclonal 10–85%, rare < 10%; the most prevalent alteration per gene and patient). Parallel subclonal hits are candidate convergent events; click a tag for the alteration's cells and reads.
cohort.empty: No single-cell patients in this dataset. Patients are datafiles.json entries with entry_type "patient".
cohort.heatmap-title: Total copy number across the cohort
cohort.tmb-help: Tree-mapped SNV sites used to build each patient's tree: truncal = mapped to the tumor MRCA, subclonal = an internal node below it, private = one cell. 'Per Mb' divides by an approximate callable territory (median breadth of the tumor cells × 3,100 Mb); patients without breadth QC show n/a.
cohort.tmb-empty: No tree-mapped SNV sites loaded yet.
cohort.signatures-help: SigProfilerAssignment fits (COSMIC v3.4) from each patient's signatures.json; hover a segment for the aetiology.
cohort.oncoprint-help: Each cell is the strongest alteration of that gene in that patient, shaded by the fraction of tumor cells carrying it (label). Several alteration classes stack as stripes. Bars on top count altered genes per patient; the right column counts patients per gene. Click to open the patient.
cohort.scatter-help: One point per patient. Click a point to open the patient.
cohort.genes-note: one bar per patient, stacked by alteration class
cohort.circos-title: Alterations of the chosen genes across patients (circos)
cohort.circos-help: One ring per patient (outer = first). Marks sit at the gene's locus, coloured by alteration class with opacity = fraction of tumor cells; fusions are arcs between the partner loci (width = fraction). Gene names label the first occurrence.
cohort.heatmap-help: Cmd/Ctrl + wheel (or pinch) zooms, drag pans, click a chromosome to zoom to it, double-click resets.
cohort.rna-empty: No RNA data for these patients yet.
cohort.rna-markers: Markers of each {{field}} shared across patients
cohort.rna-markers-empty: No pipeline markers for this field yet.
cohort.rna-markers-help: Top 25 Seurat markers per group in each patient; a tag's number is how many patients list the gene (green = all or all but one). Click a gene to plot it across patients.
cohort.rna-gene-intro: Type a gene (or click a marker) to load each patient's expression matrix and compare.
cohort.rna-gene-help: Log-normalized expression per patient; the table gives mean (and % expressing) per group of the chosen field.
cohort.umap-title: Integrated RNA UMAP across patients ({{count}} cells)
cohort.umap-missing: No cohort UMAP yet: run the pipeline's cohort_rna step (merges the Seurat objects, Harmony on patient, UMAP).
cohort.umap-help: Merged Seurat objects, Harmony-corrected for patient; colour by patient or any metadata field; hide patients; click a cell to open its patient.
cohort.dosage-title: Copy number vs expression across patients
cohort.dosage-intro: Spearman ρ between a gene's copy number (each cell's genome graph) and its expression, per patient, for the chosen genes (defaults: the cohort's amplified / deleted drivers). Loads each patient's expression matrix.
cohort.dosage-help: Red = expression follows copy number, blue = anti-correlated; * p < 0.01. Grey: fewer than 8 cells with both DNA and RNA.

compare.no-rna: This patient has no pre-analysed RNA (rna/ folder) yet.

toolbar.clip-help: Branches longer than 3× the 95th percentile (e.g. a normal outgroup) are drawn shortened and marked with //

palette.title: Copy-number colours
palette.note: Saved in this browser. The last colour is used for that state and above.
palette.theme-help: Colours for clones, groups, UMAP fields, violins, signatures and saved groups. The heatmap copy-number colours are set separately below.

events.segment-help: Median width (Mb) of the copy-number segment behind a deletion / amplification in its carrier cells; red when most carriers have a segment under 1 Mb.
events.segment-detail: {{narrow}}/{{n}} carriers with a segment under 1 Mb · flanking copy number {{flank}}
events.summary: {{snvs}} SNV sites · {{genes}} copy-number / fusion events · {{cells}} cells carrying them
events.help: Tick events below to show them on the Single-Cell heatmap: SNVs filter the SNV heatmap to those sites, copy-number changes and fusions zoom the CN heatmap to their genes, and the cells carrying them are selected.
events.strong-help: Hide likely noise: deletions must be in at least 10% of tumor cells, other events in at least 3 cells and 5% of tumor cells. Turn off to see every event.
events.show-on-tree: Show {{count}} as strips on the tree
events.clade-score-help: How well the carrier cells follow the phylogeny: best F1 between the carriers and any clade of the tree. 1 = exactly one clade; low values mean scattered cells, typical of noisy junction or deletion calls.
events.clade-score-detail: {{inClade}} of the {{carriers}} carriers sit in the best clade of {{clade}} cells

dosage.title: Dosage vs expression
dosage.summary: {{gene}}: {{n}} cells with DNA and RNA · Spearman ρ {{rho}} · slope {{slope}} log-expression per copy
dosage.no-gene: {{gene}} is not in both the RNA matrix and the gene annotation
dosage.rank-intro: Rank all genes by the correlation between copy number at their locus and their expression (cells with both DNA and RNA).
dosage.rank-help: {{count}} genes expressed in at least 10 cells; click a gene to plot it
dosage.by-chromosome-help: Share of ranked genes on each chromosome whose expression follows copy number (Spearman ρ ≥ 0.3); red when the chromosome's median ρ is ≥ 0.3.
dosage.help: One panel per gene; click a point to select the cell, drag a box to select cells (Shift adds). Selection is shared with the tree below, the heatmap and the UMAP.
dosage.legend-note: point colour = clone; dashed line = least-squares fit

rna-findings.title: Expression (RNA)
rna-findings.help: Cells with both DNA and RNA, joined by cell ID. Clone tests: Fisher's exact test of each clone against the other tumor cells, BH-adjusted (q < 0.05). Driver expression: Wilcoxon test of the driver gene in carriers vs the other DNA-linked cells (log2FC as Seurat). Marker genes: Seurat-style Wilcoxon DE of the clone vs the other tumor cells (Bonferroni p < 0.05, log2FC ≥ 1); red = also a driver gene.

rna-fusions.title: RNA fusions
rna-fusions.help: Computed in the back end: each cell's RNA was aligned with STAR (chimeric mode) and fusions called per cell with Arriba 2.5.0; calls of the same breakpoints were merged across cells. Confidence is the best across cells. Per-cell read slices (±300 bp of each breakpoint) carry the tag ZF:i:1 on reads supporting the fusion. The DNA match is computed in the back end (same gene pair, or a DNA junction near the breakpoints); the strip and filters are computed in the browser.

splicing.title: Splicing
splicing.help: Computed in the back end: splice junctions were extracted from each cell's RNA alignment with regtools and grouped into LeafCutter-style intron clusters (junctions sharing a splice site); known variants (EGFRvIII, MET exon 14 skipping, PDGFRA Δ8–9, …) are counted from their alternative and reference junctions. The patient file keeps the ~150 clusters most variable between this patient's cells. PSI (junction usage) per group is computed here, in the browser, by pooling the reads of the cells in the group.
splicing.none: No splicing results for this patient yet.
splicing.error: Could not load the splicing results: {{error}}
splicing.variant-summary: {{alt}} alternative / {{ref}} reference reads; {{nAlt}} of {{nCells}} covered cells have alternative reads.
splicing.variant-strip-help: Each column is an RNA cell in phylogeny order (RNA-only cells after the gap). Top: alternative junction reads; bottom: reference junction reads (darker = more reads).
splicing.no-clusters: No intron clusters in the file.
splicing.arcs-help: Each arc is a junction of the cluster (positions ordinal, not to scale; dashed: unannotated). Arc width and label: junction usage (PSI) in the group, pooled over its cells; n = reads in the cluster.
splicing.strip-help: Rows are the cluster's junctions, columns RNA cells in phylogeny order (RNA-only cells after the gap); colour = the cell's PSI for that junction, blank = no reads in the cluster.
splicing.cohort-help: Computed in the back end: junction counts per patient (regtools, pooled over cells) in LeafCutter-style intron clusters, tested for differences in usage between patients with a chi-square test, Benjamini–Hochberg q; the top ~300 clusters by significance / ΔPSI are kept. PSI per patient is computed here from the pooled counts.
